ns2:course.label: Structure of Graphs
ns2:course.description: Structure of graphs and properties of special classes of graphs. Degree sequences and reconstruction, structure of k-connected graphs, Hamiltonian cycles and circumference, planar graphs and their properties, graph minors, cycle coverings, matroidal and algebraic aspects of graphs. Prerequisite: MATH 580 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MATH 580 or consent of instructor.
